perms.you: Your base role on the website. Custom roles add permissions on top of a member's base role.
perms.roles: The custom roles you hold on the website, and whether you were added to each or hold it through a linked Discord role.
perms.manage: This page is read only. Permissions are managed in the website panel, and a change there reaches this page within seconds.
perms.openRanks: Opens the Ranks page here. It edits the same website roles, within what you may delegate.
perms.search: Filters the permissions by name, description or code name. Example: type ban.

filter.locked: The permissions you do not hold.

perms.details: Shows each permission's code name as the website uses it. Useful when you ask the owner for one.
perms.web: The website panel's permissions with the same names as its Roles & Permissions page. Some open the tools of this in-game panel.
perms.scripts: In-game script command permissions, one script at a time. Website permissions do not grant them automatically.
perms.script: This script's permissions. The number is how many you hold out of all of them.

col.perm: The permission's name as the website shows it.
col.you: Whether you hold this permission now.

roleLine.owner: Every permission, including console commands and the connection token.
roleLine.base: Custom roles add permissions on top of a member's base role.
roleLine.custom: You have no base role; your permissions come from custom roles only.

perms.manageTitle: Permissions are managed on the website
perms.manage: This page is read only. To change permissions, open: %s
perms.manageNoWhere: This page is read only. To change permissions, open the website panel, Roles & Permissions.
perms.manageRanks: Anyone with Manage roles and permissions can also edit the same roles on the Ranks page here.
perms.noWebNames: Website permission names appear once the website is updated. Your permissions show by their code names here.
perms.search: Search by permission name or description…
perms.scriptsLead: Website permissions do not grant script commands automatically. Each script's permissions are chosen in the role.
perms.scriptsFromServer: Script permissions show here as the server applies them right now.
perms.noScripts: The current server list has no available script permissions.
perms.noScriptsHeld: You have no in-game permissions. Website permissions do not grant script commands automatically.
perms.scriptsUnknown: Permissions granted to you that are not in the current list: %s.
perms.say: You can use %s of %s website permissions and %s of %s script permissions.
